elements.name: zone
elements.label: Availability zone
elements.toolTip: Select a logical zone offered in this subscription and region; the size selector below uses this zone.

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: Host VM size
elements.toolTip: Only documented nested-virtualization families Dsv5, Dasv5, Esv5 and Easv5 with x64/Gen2 support, at least 4 vCPUs and 32 GB RAM are offered. Sizes are discovered for your subscription and region, then filtered for the selected zone. Quota and live capacity must still be checked.

constraints.allowedSizes: [if(or(not(empty(steps('hosts').compatibleSizes.nextLink)), empty(filter(filter(steps('hosts').compatibleSizes.value, (sku) => equals(sku.resourceType, 'virtualMachines')), (sku) => and(contains(parse('["standarddsv5family","standarddasv5family","standardesv5family","standardeasv5family"]'), toLower(sku.family)), not(contains(sku.name, '-')), not(empty(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => and(equals(cap.name, 'CpuArchitectureType'), equals(cap.value, 'x64'))))), not(empty(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => and(equals(cap.name, 'HyperVGenerations'), contains(cap.value, 'V2'))))), not(empty(filter(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => equals(cap.name, 'MemoryGB')), (cap) => greaterOrEquals(int(first(split(cap.value, '.'))), 32)))), not(empty(filter(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => equals(cap.name, 'vCPUs')), (cap) => greaterOrEquals(int(cap.value), 4)))))))), parse('["__NoCompatibleSizeAvailable__"]'), map(filter(filter(steps('hosts').compatibleSizes.value, (sku) => equals(sku.resourceType, 'virtualMachines')), (sku) => and(contains(parse('["standarddsv5family","standarddasv5family","standardesv5family","standardeasv5family"]'), toLower(sku.family)), not(contains(sku.name, '-')), not(empty(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => and(equals(cap.name, 'CpuArchitectureType'), equals(cap.value, 'x64'))))), not(empty(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => and(equals(cap.name, 'HyperVGenerations'), contains(cap.value, 'V2'))))), not(empty(filter(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => equals(cap.name, 'MemoryGB')), (cap) => greaterOrEquals(int(first(split(cap.value, '.'))), 32)))), not(empty(filter(filter(sku.capabilities, (cap) => equals(cap.name, 'vCPUs')), (cap) => greaterOrEquals(int(cap.value), 4)))))), (sku) => sku.name))]
